chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa narrated from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from Ali ibn Abi Hamzah, from Abi Basir, from Abi Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
"He does not marry the woman who accepted him, nor her daughter."
ai.seo_question: What is the prohibition regarding marrying a woman who accepted a man and her daughter?
ai.summary: In the context of *tahdhib-al-ahkam*'s chapter on childbirth, this hadith from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies the specific marital prohibition of *mahramiyyah* arising from a valid marriage contract. It establishes that once a man is 'accepted' by a woman—signifying the consummation or formalization of the union—he becomes permanently prohibited from marrying her, as well as her direct female descendants, reinforcing the principle of lineage-based kinship in Shia jurisprudence.
